findings.claim_text: The only independently, controlled-benchmarked figure anywhere in this field — METR's 2.01x average speedup — sits well below several of the self-reported multiples it should be calibrating[^4].
findings.contradicting_quote: Ranked #1 on MLSys 2026 - FlashInfer AI Kernel Generation Contest (Agent-only)... with an average speedup of 34.93x

findings.claim_text: Two efficiency shocks eighteen months apart (DeepSeek 2025, this current wave) have coincided with hyperscaler capex accelerating, not decelerating — and no credible analyst isolates "AI-automated kernel writing" as its own distinct efficiency lever[^36][^38][^39].
As of 2026, no neutral third party has published a resourced-equivalent replication that settles which side is right — this is a live, unresolved dispute, not a debunked claim or a vindicated one.
